Бензододециния Хлорид C21H38ClN = 340.0. CAS — 139-07-1. ATC — D09AA05. ATC Vet — QD09AA05. NOTE. The name Lauralkonium Chloride is also a rINN for anoth- er quaternary ammonium compound (C29H44ClNO2; CAS – 19486-61-4). Profile Benzododecinium bromide is a quaternary ammonium antiseptic with properties similar to those of other cationic surfactants (see Cetrimide, p.1634). It is used in mouthwashes, eye preparations, and nasal sprays and solutions for the treatment of minor infec- tions. It has also been used as a spermicide. Benzododecinium chloride has also been used. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Cz.: Ajatin; Fr.: Rhinedrine.
